matched_queries: UK employment guidance: Qualifying service and eligibility to claim ordinary unfair dismissal, including exceptions and effective termination dates.
Discover UK employment guidance for Unfair dismissal qualifying period. Task relevance is separate from current law, commencement and a need to edit.

passages.quote:
You can take a case to an employment tribunal if you’ve been treated unfairly because you’ve blown the whistle.

You can get further information from the Advisory, Conciliation and Arbitration Service (Acas), Citizens’ Advice, the whistleblowing charity Protect or your trade union.

If you reported your concern anonymously, you may find it harder to argue that your unfair treatment was as a result of your whistleblowing.

You usually have to raise any claim of unfair dismissal within 6 months of your employment ending. If your employment ended before 1 October 2026, you may need to make a claim within 3 months.

You must notify Acas if you want to take your case to an employment tribunal.
